name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti product page (8 GB GDDR6, 256-bit, 200 W)
notes: Founders Edition spec table: 4864 CUDA cores, boost 1.67 GHz, base 1.41 GHz, 8 GB GDDR6, 256-bit, graphics card power 200 W, Ampere, PCIe Gen4. Bandwidth is not printed on this page; 14 Gbps x 256-bit = 448 GB/s is the arithmetic of the printed bus and the GDDR6 rate used across the 3060 Ti FE, and is recorded as derived in memory_bandwidth_basis rather than as a quoted figure.
